name: amfx-gbpusd-fix-cumret
description: amFX reproduction (24JAN23 p2): Cumulative GBPUSD performance going long 10am-11am NY every day, 2010-2022. One of the most striking FX microstructure charts: +5% by 2014, collapse to -14% by 2020 (Brexit period — real money hedgers persistently sold GBP at the fix), partial recovery to ~-6% by 2022. Reveals structural fix flow patterns that persist for years. Source: amFX 24JAN23 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: GBPUSD FIX WINDOW CUMULATIVE RETURN (24JAN23 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Unconditional: go long GBPUSD 10am-11am NY every trading day.
# Cumulate daily fix window returns from 2010 to 2022.
# Original chart shape: +5% by 2014, collapse to -14% by 2020
# (Brexit hedging flows), partial recovery to ~-6% by 2022.
# Reveals structural flow patterns that persist for YEARS.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Time of day in NY timezone (minutes from midnight)
bar_idx = index()
bar_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_idx)

# 60-minute return at each bar
ret_60 = roc(period=60)(close)

# At 11am ET (bar_tod=660), ret_60 = 10am-11am return. Zero elsewhere.
fix_ret = ret_60 if (bar_tod == 660.0) else 0.0

# Cumulative return (percentage)
cum_ret = cumulative()(fix_ret) * 100.0

# Filter to 11am bars for plotting
cum_ret_plot = cum_ret if (bar_tod == 660.0) else 0.0 / 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CHART: Cumulative Fix Window Return
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='GBPUSD: What If You Bought 10am-11am NY Every Day?',
    category='Fix Window Return',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GBPUSD Fix Window', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_idx, cum_ret_plot)
